Rae N: Quick postmortem follow-up — need owners for customer comms and a clear plan for tracking remediation across repeat incidents. Who takes the status page, public summary, and the recurring-pattern register?
Diego H: I can draft the statuspage line and a short public summary. ETA tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Will keep the page copy 1-2 sentences and the summary ~300 words.
Sylvie M: Support will produce the affected account export and add impact tiers + AM contacts. I'll have the CSV by EOD today and mark SLA customers.
Kent O: Proposal: publish a 2-line status update now, then publish a longer "customer timeline + sanitized summary" within 48h. Also create a shared remediation tracker spreadsheet (owner, ETA, verification steps) and link it from the summary.
Legal Team: Confirmed: short status note ok to publish. Anything with customer identifiers, raw logs, or internal traces requires review and typically a signed DSA. We'll provide a redaction checklist and sample "request more" language.
Rae N: Good. Add one more: we need a recurring-pattern register to capture whether this incident is part of a larger trend (e.g., routing flaps during autoscale). Product + SRE should own weekly triage for 6 weeks.
Diego H: I'll include a "customer timeline" section in the public summary (high-level events) and a link to the remediation tracker (read-only). The tracker will not expose logs.
Sylvie M: For outreach cadence: SLA customers get a proactive tailored email within 24h of summary sign-off. All affected customers see the sanitized summary via statuspage + ticket within 48h. Support will coordinate AM outreach for flagged accounts.
Kent O: Action items: Diego -> statuspage + public summary draft by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Sylvie -> affected-account CSV + SLA flags by EOD today. Legal -> redaction checklist + "request more" template in 24h. Rae -> create remediation tracker and recurring-pattern register, assign weekly owner by tomorrow COB.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 moved to postmortem by @rae at 2026-04-12T16:12:01Z.
Rae N: Also: create an automated reminder to verify remediation (owner marks "verified" after 7 days post-fix) and record verification evidence (test results summary, not raw logs). I'll add that to the tracker.
Legal Team: We'll circulate the redaction checklist and a short FAQ for AMs on what they can share without escalation.
Diego H: Draft posted to #incidents-drafts — please do a quick pass (tone + redaction) so we can publish the statusline ASAP.
Rae N: Solid. I'll capture owners/timelines in the incident action tracker and follow up at the Wednesday check-in. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
